levelTitle.id: Level 0: Fondasi Pemula (Dari Awam ke Mindset Engineer)
levelTitle.en: Level 0: Layman's Onboarding (From Novice to Engineer)

levelSubtitle.id: Pahami analogi dunia nyata, mental model aliran data, setup komputer, dan fondasi database tanpa jargon rumit.
levelSubtitle.en: Understand real-world analogies, mental models of data flow, environment setup, and database fundamentals without confusing jargon.

levelTitle.id: Level 1: Fondasi Rekayasa (The Software Engineering Mindset)

levelSubtitle.id: Tinggalkan notebook rapuh. Pelajari Linux, Python produksi, SQL tingkat lanjut, dan pemodelan dimensional.
levelSubtitle.en: Stop writing brittle notebooks. Learn Linux, production Python, advanced SQL, and dimensional modeling.

levelSubtitle.id: Bangun lakehouse mandiri di laptop dengan Apache Iceberg, DuckDB, dbt Core, Dagster, dan Data Contracts.
levelSubtitle.en: Build local-first lakehouses with Apache Iceberg, DuckDB, dbt Core, Dagster, and Data Contracts.

levelSubtitle.id: Kuasai komputasi terdistribusi (Spark Internals), event streaming (Kafka/Redpanda), CDC, Flink, dan Terraform IaC.
levelSubtitle.en: Master distributed computing internals (Spark/Flink), event streaming (Kafka/Redpanda), CDC, and Terraform IaC.
